02 Where MCTV Fits
Eat With Us × MCTV

Your guests are our audience.

01

Twelve dining rooms inside our map.

Harvey's and The Grill anchor Starkville, Columbus, and Tupelo; Bulldog Burger, Sweet Peppers, Smackers, and Super Chix fill in the rest. No other advertiser overlaps our territory the way you already do.

02

Our rooms are your dinner crowd.

The salon chair, the gym, the clinic waiting room, the wine shop — 123 screens in the rooms where the Golden Triangle and Tupelo decide where to eat tonight.

03

The last thing they see before they eat.

A seated audience, 55+ minutes at a time, every 15 minutes all month. When someone leaves a haircut at 5 p.m., Bulldog Burger is the last brand they saw.

04

One family, one campaign.

Six concepts share one contract: a rotating quarterly spotlight, a group bumper that keeps the whole family on screen, and finished creative you own forever — in any market.

Where the screens live

Our screens sit inside the restaurants, medical clinics, salons, dealerships, pharmacies, co-ops, and civic buildings North Mississippians already spend their week in. Dwell time is measured in tens of minutes, not seconds — your spot plays to a seated, waiting audience.

With dining rooms in Starkville, Columbus, and Tupelo — and Oxford's game-day corridor feeding all three — every market we operate is a market that feeds you.

What sets MCTV apart

01

Owner-operated and local. The fastest-growing owner-operated indoor billboard network in North America — run from North Mississippi.

02

Unskippable by design. No remote, no ad-blocker, no scroll. Your spot can't be skipped, muted into irrelevance, or thrown away.

03

A captive, seated audience. 1,500+ plays per screen every month, in rooms where people are waiting anyway.

04

Accountable. Proof-of-play reporting documents play counts by screen — you see exactly where and how often your ad ran.
